{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load the sales data with proper parsing of revenue
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string with commas to float
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for sentinel values in customer_age
print("Sentinel value counts in customer_age:")
print(sales_df['customer_age'].value_counts().sort_index())

# Check for duplicates
print("\nDuplicate rows:")
print(sales_df.duplicated().sum())

# Check distribution of converted
print("\nConverted distribution:")
print(sales_df['converted'].value_counts())"}
